The '''updraft tome''' is an {{MCD|artifact}} that can be found within the {{MCD|Howling Peaks}} {{MCD|DLC}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Missions ===
* {{DuLevelLink|Windswept Peaks}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Gauntlet of Gales}}

=== Merchants ===
* {{DuEntityLink|Village Merchant}}
* {{DuEntityLink|Gift Wrapper}}
* {{DuEntityLink|Mystery Merchant}}
* {{DuEntityLink|Luxury Merchant}}

== Usage ==
The updraft tome can be used to lift up to seven mobs into the air, stunning and damaging mobs that don't have immunity. Similar to other status inflicting artifacts, (the [[MCD:Corrupted Seeds|corrupted seeds]], the [[MCD:Love Medallion|love medallion]], the [[MCD:Satchel of Elements|satchel of elements]], the [[MCD:Gong of Weakening|gong of weakening]], the [[MCD:Shock Powder|shock powder]]) the updraft tome only targets hostile and neutral mobs and does not effect entities around the targeted mobs.

Unlike other damaging artifacts, having fast artifact cooldown (using [[MCD:Cool Down|cool down]]s and [[MCD:Cooldown Shot|cooldown shot]]) can harm the effectiveness of updraft tomes, as it is the only damaging artifact that cancels its own activation if activated more than once on a single target. This is because the damaging swirl of wind created by the updraft tome is canceled if another swirl of wind is created on the same target.

== Properties ==
* X artifact damage
* X second stun duration
* 7 targets maximum
* 12 second cooldown
